blocks.text: Juggling multiple responsibilities can leave little room for the hobbies we once enjoyed. What used to be a regular part of our lives can slowly take a stop as work, school, errands, and other responsibilities take priority. Maybe you used to spend hours reading books, playing video games, drawing, collecting things, or learning how to play an instrument. Now, those hobbies sit untouched as you find yourself saying, “I’ll get back to it when I have more time.” But sometimes, it’s not just about having less time.
